8acf4ac33a9e: Avonni offers a wide library of Salesforce components, a calendar and scheduler among them. MultiDatePick is one calendar suite built around picking dates and booking time. How they compare, and when to pick each.
d85c441a60ef: Avonni is a familiar name for Salesforce admins who build with components: data tables, Kanban boards, charts, and a Calendar that doubles as a Scheduler. It is a toolkit, and its calendar is one piece of it. MultiDatePick is narrower and deeper: a calendar suite whose whole job is dates, time slots and bookings saved as Salesforce records.
7cdb03684abb: Both are native and configured without code. Which one fits depends on whether you need a broad toolkit or booking rules out of the box.

d55861c89100: A component library gives you building blocks: you decide what the calendar shows, then wire up what happens when someone drags or clicks. That is ideal when your process is unusual and you have the time to shape it. MultiDatePick ships the finished scheduling behavior: pick, check, save. If what you need is "let people book rooms without double booking" or "let a manager pick the twelve dates of a training series", it is a configuration, not a build.
